text: Amazon's first name sounded like a dead body.
In July 1994, Jeff Bezos set up his new online bookstore. He called it Cadabra.
say: In July nineteen ninety-four, Jeff Bezos set up his new online bookstore. He called it Cadabra.

text: Then his lawyer heard the name over the phone and asked, cadaver?
A cadaver is a dead body. Not great for a shop.
So Bezos tried other names, like Relentless, and registered relentless.com.
say: So Bezos tried other names, like Relentless, and registered relentless dot com.

text: Then he found Amazon in the dictionary. The biggest river in the world.
And it starts with A, so it sat near the top of alphabetical lists.
The wild part? Type relentless.com into your browser, and it still takes you to Amazon.
say: The wild part? Type relentless dot com into your browser, and it still takes you to Amazon.

text: The lesson? Say your business name out loud before you buy the domain.
If people mishear it, they can't find you.
